usage: python PoC-takeaway/build.py            # all assets from committed, authorized results (~10 min: GIFs re-verify physics)

python PoC-takeaway/build.py --refresh-p17  # refuses unless P17_FINAL_MANIFEST.json + UNSEALED exist and the sealed manifest is on origin/main; then fills P17 columns in 03/04 and re-selects all five GIFs from the P17 test by fixed rules
about: Inputs for build.py. Every number in the figures is computed by build.py from the files named here (or quoted from the named report line). P17 results stay PENDING until --refresh-p17 passes its custody checks.

colors.palette_note: Checked with an OKLab distance + Machado CVD simulation script (the dataviz node validator is not installed here): worst normal-vision dE 18.0 (A-C), worst CVD dE 7.9 (A-C, inside the 6-8 band that is legal only with secondary encoding) - every colour is always paired with a text label. B+G is a lighter step of B on purpose (a B variant). Orange is left to the simulator target; green / amber / red are reserved for outcome status.

definitions.scenes: 326 development scenes with P17 existential labels (P16 train / dev / val / calib + p17train + p17calib; committed a4a15414); each generated independently, no base x variant hierarchy recorded

definitions.infeasible scenes repaired: infeasible scenes with >= 1 repair sequence labelled y = 1 (VERIFIED + replay CLEAR) / all infeasible scenes

A.note: arm 'A' = A architecture retrained on that phase's data (P16 0088 'A (retrained)'); the frozen P13 A checkpoint is 'P13:A' (not shown)

B.note: production lean B; experimental LB+G (generic coupling) not shown (P16 operational: detected 55/63, false alarms 25/72, resolved 35/63)

C.note: historical C checkpoint frozen in P13; NOT the LC control (P16 operational: 56/63, 32/72, 32/63)

D.note: D's learned original-target feasibility (raw seed-ensemble p_feasible) for detection; D-guided search for resolution

definitions.ground truth: operational class of the recorded ORIGINAL status (P16: B execution row y0_status; P17: labels original status)
definitions.A/B/C detected: infeasible roots where the arm's choice is not EMPTY (a repair OR an abstention both flag the scene as blocked) / infeasible roots
definitions.A/B/C false alarms: feasible roots where the choice is not EMPTY / feasible roots
definitions.A/B/C resolved: infeasible roots where a non-empty repair was chosen and its execution status is VERIFIED with replay CLEAR (UNKNOWN / timeout = not resolved) / infeasible roots
definitions.D detected / false alarms: p_feasible < 0.5 on infeasible / feasible roots (raw seed ensemble, not the planner)
definitions.D resolved: D search found a plan with >= 1 move and replay CLEAR on an infeasible root / infeasible roots; 0-move plans on infeasible roots are label-vs-search-budget disagreements (counted in computed_p17.d_zero_move_on_infeasible at refresh)

p16_render.D: Pending: P16 has only 17 matched roots (B and D both executed), all originally infeasible, so false alarms are undefined; the P16 D test (21 of 48 constructed roots) is a different, unmatched cohort and is NOT mixed into this table

gifs.protocol: P16 frozen test (sealed then unsealed in P16). A/B/C panels: the arm's recorded choice, re-verified deterministically with the P16 sequence verifier (status must equal the record). D panel: P16 production D (Dp16) plan, regenerated and accepted only if its replay hash equals the recorded Dp16 hash. Robot motion is drawn only from certified arrays.
gifs.p17_rule: --refresh-p17 re-selects all five slots from the unsealed P17 test: first root in plan order matching each contrast (A/B/C: strict task success as in the analysis; D: found + replay CLEAR), preferring roots executed by all four; no match -> PENDING slot.

operational_convention: Takeaway-only reading of the raw records (never modified): FEASIBLE = recorded status VERIFIED (+ replay CLEAR where a replay applies); everything else (CERTIFIED_INFEASIBLE, STATIC_INVALID, any UNKNOWN_*, budget exhaustion) = INFEASIBLE. Applied to originals, repair sequences and executed choices in 02 / 03.
